decisions.briefing: Markets were neutral today with NASDAQ down 0.6% and the S&P 500 down 0.3% — no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($389.29) is below the $500 deployment threshold, and per past lessons we don't force buys on neutral days just to fill open slots, so all 7 existing positions are held unchanged while we wait for a genuine risk-on setup.

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices drifted slightly lower today in quiet, directionless trading, with no single catalyst driving the move. Volume and volatility were modest, consistent with a market in a holding pattern rather than reacting to major news. Without a strong risk-on or risk-off signal, it was a day better suited to patience than new positioning.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢平淡，納指下跌0.6%，標普500指數下跌0.3%，並無明顯的單一消息面因素主導市場。成交量與波動度皆屬溫和水平，顯示市場處於觀望整理階段，而非對重大消息作出反應。在缺乏明確的風險偏好或避險訊號下，今日較適合按兵不動，而非貿然新增倉位。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors hold back from new bets because market signals aren't clearly bullish or bearish. Even with cash available and open portfolio slots, it's often better to wait for stronger confirmation (like a clear market rally) than to force a trade just to stay 'fully invested'.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險趨避」（Risk-Off）是指在市場訊號不夠明確看多或看空時，投資人選擇按兵不動、不貿然進場。即使手上有現金、投資組合也還有空位，等待更明確的訊號（例如市場明顯上漲）通常比為了「用滿資金」而勉強交易更為穩健。
